item.title: Blowhorn vs Buffer
item.description:
A 36-second film from the Buffer comparison. Buffer is a fine calendar. It also holds your token, and its cloud is what publishes. Blowhorn is you, on your own computer, under your own profile. You stay in command: dry-run, one send, outreach hygiene, Take leave.

See the full write-up on the Blowhorn vs Buffer page.
